name: Hocoos
tagline: Hocoos is an AI website builder that creates complete, publish-ready websites in minutes by asking a few questions about your business. Small business owners use it to get a professional website with generated copy, images, and structure without design or coding skills. The result includes hosting, a domain, and built-in tools for booking, e-commerce, and contact forms.
